The term '''Holy Artifact''' was given to any piece of scrap and junk present in the [[Ugor/Legends|Ugor's]] [[Paradise system/Legends|Paradise system]] that "[[Pilgrim (Ugor)|Pilgrims]]" were allow to remove from the system during a visit. The price for each "Artifact" was assessed upon leaving the [[Star system/Legends|star system]].<ref name="Scavenger Hunt">[[Scavenger Hunt (adventure)|''Scavenger Hunt'']]</ref>
